mechanism: Chlorthalidone may cause hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate rizatriptan's vasoconstrictive effects and increase risk of cardiovascular events; additionally, thiazide diuretics can reduce renal clearance and increase triptan levels.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, ensure adequate hydration, and assess cardiovascular status; consider alternative antihypertensive if frequent triptan use is anticipated.
